comment_ja: 昨日は16件中12勝3敗1分で💰+4,020円。O/Uやハンディキャップ系が安定して機能した一方、勝敗予想は3件中1勝2敗と苦戦した。注目点は両チーム得点「あり」の的中(オッズ1.98、+980円)。累計は1,352件で勝った割合55.6%、戻ってきた割合は📉-3.4%と依然マイナス圏が続く。
comment_en: Yesterday went 12W-3L-1P across 16 picks, for a net gain of +4,020 yen 💰. O/U and handicap markets performed steadily, while straight win/loss predictions struggled at 1W-2L. A standout was the Both Teams to Score 'Yes' hit at odds 1.98 (+980 yen). Cumulatively over 1,352 picks, the win rate sits at 55.6%, but the return rate remains in negative territory at 📉-3.4%.
